name: UnlistedRoles
description:
Search jobs sourced from company career pages and filter by role, country, work arrangement, and salary. Read available job details and direct application links, view your saved jobs, and check your remaining free unlocks from Claude. Open a job on UnlistedRoles to unlock it or save it to your tracker.

Start free with 20 job unlocks per month, no card required. Pro includes unlimited job unlocks for $2.99/month.

The connector is read-only and accesses only the account you connect. It does not submit applications, contact employers, access resumes or Claude conversation history, or change billing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add UnlistedRoles to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add UnlistedRoles to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://unlistedroles.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the UnlistedRoles MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: UnlistedRoles provides these MCP tools: get_account, get_job, list_saved_jobs, and search_jobs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to UnlistedRoles?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to UnlistedRoles in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
UnlistedRoles requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
UnlistedRoles is developed by UnlistedRoles. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
